findings.element: Horizontal dimension chain, segment between inside face of left exterior wall and the 11.5 cm partition (WOHNEN width)
findings.explanation: The dimension line for this segment runs from x=121.89 pt to x=286.30 pt = 164.41 pt. At 1:100 (1 pt = 35.278 mm real) that is 5.800 m, not the labelled 5.86 m. Discrepancy 6 cm.

findings.element: Horizontal dimension chain, segment between the 11.5 cm partition and inside face of right exterior wall (SCHLAFEN / BAD width)
findings.explanation: The dimension line runs from x=289.56 pt to x=388.35 pt = 98.79 pt = 3.485 m at 1:100. The label reads 4.00 m, an overstatement of 51.5 cm.

findings.kind: dimension chain does not sum to overall dimension
findings.element: Top dimension chain 30 / 5.86 / 11.5 / 4.00 / 30 versus overall dimension 10.00
findings.explanation: 0.30 + 5.86 + 0.115 + 4.00 + 0.30 = 10.575 m, but the overall dimension above it reads 10.00 m and the building is drawn 283.46 pt = 10.000 m wide. The chain overshoots by 57.5 cm. Using the as-drawn segment lengths (0.30 + 5.80 + 0.115 + 3.485 + 0.30) the chain closes at exactly 10.00 m, so the two mislabelled segments are the cause.
Drawn clear room is x 121.89-286.30 pt (5.800 m) by y 433.70-615.12 pt (6.400 m) = 37.12 m2. The label understates the area by 5.9 m2 (16%).

Drawn clear room is x 289.56-388.35 pt (3.485 m) by y 552.76-615.12 pt (2.200 m) = 7.67 m2, not 6.9 m2. The three labelled areas total 51.5 m2 against 59.03 m2 of net floor area actually drawn (checked: 9.40 x 6.40 gross interior minus the two 11.5 cm partitions).

findings.kind: door symbol drawn on the wrong side of its opening
findings.element: Door between WOHNEN and SCHLAFEN, in the 11.5 cm partition
findings.explanation: The wall opening is the gap at y 504.57-532.91 pt in the partition, but the door leaf and swing arc occupy y 476.22-504.57 pt - the quarter-circle is mirrored about the hinge, so it sweeps solid wall while the actual opening is left unswept. The BAD door (opening x 295.23-320.74 pt, swing over exactly that range) and the entrance door are drawn correctly, confirming this one is the outlier. Note also that BAD is only reachable through SCHLAFEN, which the contractor may want confirmed.

summary: The drawing geometry itself is internally consistent (overall 10.00 x 7.00 m, 30 cm exterior walls, 11.5 cm partitions, all confirmed at the stated 1:100), but seven annotations contradict it. Two chain dimensions are mislabelled (5.86 should read 5.80; 4.00 should read 3.49), which makes the chain sum to 10.575 m against the 10.00 m overall. All three room areas are understated (WOHNEN 31.2 vs 37.12, SCHLAFEN 13.4 vs 14.24, BAD 6.9 vs 7.67 m2), and the SCHLAFEN door swing is drawn mirrored so it sits beside its opening rather than over it. Please reconcile the partition position and the area schedule before this goes out.
